extracts.name: newAccountNumber
extracts.description: The account number of the newly opened SAVINGS account, shown on the confirmation page.

checkpoint.textPresent: Congratulations, your account is now open.

outcomes.name: LOGIN_REJECTED
outcomes.description: The supplied username/password was not accepted by ParaBank; no account can be opened.

detect.textPresent: The username and password could not be verified.

outcomes.name: ACCOUNT_OPEN_FAILED
outcomes.description: ParaBank could not open the new savings account (e.g. the pre-selected funding account cannot cover the $100.00 minimum opening deposit, or the request errored). No account number is returned.

finish.name: Open ParaBank Savings Account
finish.description: Logs into ParaBank with vaulted credentials (PARABANK_USERNAME / PARABANK_PASSWORD), opens a new SAVINGS account funded from the funding account the Open New Account form pre-selects by default, and returns the new account number as `newAccountNumber`. Submitting the application is irreversible and requires human approval on each replay. Business outcomes: LOGIN_REJECTED (credentials not verified) and ACCOUNT_OPEN_FAILED (confirmation not shown, e.g. minimum $100 opening deposit cannot be met or the request errored).
finish.summary: Logged in as the vaulted user, navigated to Open New Account, selected account type SAVINGS, left the pre-selected funding account (12345) untouched, and submitted the application (marked irreversible). Confirmation page "Account Opened!" appeared and the new account number 13566 was declared as the output newAccountNumber. Checkpoints recorded at each step; LOGIN_REJECTED and ACCOUNT_OPEN_FAILED declared as business outcomes.
